newsitem.title: USA: Community Savings holding structure OK'd.
newsitem.headline: Community Savings holding structure OK'd.

text.p: Community Savings FA said Thursday that the U.S. Office of Thrift Supervision has approved its reorganization into a two-tier mutual holding company structure.
The reorganization will create Community Savings Bankshares Inc, a federally chartered corporation.
ComFed MHC, Community Savings' mutual holding company, will hold a majority of the common stock of Community Savings Bankshares, which will own 100 percent of the common stock of Community Savings.
Each share of Community Saving's Association common stock held by existing shareholders will be converted into one share of Community Savings Bankshares.
Community Savings said it will seek shareholder approval of the plan at a special meeting on September 24.
